summary: Tested new HR (شؤون الموظفين) section in Management Dashboard. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases passed - HR structure/sums for week/month/day, permission catalog includes dashboard_hr under لوحة القيادة, RBAC correctly denies dean (Salim) and dept head (Saeed), and excel/pdf exports contain required HR sheets. Frontend: all data-testid elements render (dash-hr, headcount tiles, unit table with 4 rows, today tiles, period tiles, chart, top/bottom/units lists). Period switching updates chart subtitle to 'حسب الوحدة' for day. Deep links to /hr-employees?category=academic and ?org_unit_id=<id> work. Regression: dash-attendance-chart with 'مخطط الحضور' title still renders. manage-roles lists dashboard_hr label under لوحة القيادة.

issues: Multiple React-Native-Web console warnings: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' repeated; unknown event handler onResponderXxx warnings; shadow* deprecated; TouchableMixin deprecated. Not blocking but noisy.

critical_code_review_comments: management_dashboard.py: build_dashboard is very large (>230 lines) and getting hard to maintain — consider splitting phase-1 vs phase-2 helpers further.
hr_dashboard._headcount: total_all is computed via extra full-collection scan (db.employees.find({}, {'status':1})); acceptable given the small dataset but worth caching if data grows.

hr chart 'lectures'/'completed' fields are set from HR counts (present+late+absent) purely to reuse the DashAttendanceChart component — a mild abstraction leak; consider passing plain series props instead.
test_credentials: admin/admin123, Salim/test1234, Saeed/test1234 — all worked; no changes made to Saeed's permissions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: HR dashboard is fully working E2E. Suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_hr_dashboard.py (8 tests, ~3.5s). For frontend regression, use data-testid selectors: dash-period-day/week/month, dash-hr, dash-hr-hc-*, dash-hr-tile-*, dash-hr-period-*, dash-hr-chart. Small dataset (6 active employees, few attendance records).
